name: recourse-cre
//: Shadows the workflow's dependencies at the CRE project root. The bundler resolves from here, not from adjudicate/, so without this it walks up past the workflow's own node_modules and finds whatever viem happens to sit in an ancestor directory (there is a viem 1.18.2 at ~/ and a 2.30.1 at ~/Documents/github). A mismatched viem still compiles but produces a WASM binary that traps at engine start.
